newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Avantel says has 14 pct Queretaro market.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Avantel says has 14 pct Queretaro market.

text.p: Mexican telephone company Avantel SA said on Wednesday it has captured 14 percent of the market in the central Mexican city of Queretaro.

The company said in a statement that it has signed up a total of 11,000 customers so far in the city. Many customers were added following an initial pre-subscription process that allowed users to choose their long-distance carrier, it said.
Avantel is a joint venture between MCI Communications and Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival, Mexico's largest banking group.

Earlier on Wednesday, Mexico's Federal Telecommunications Commission said Avantel had won only about 14 percent of the pre-subscription ballots that had been tallied to January 27 in Monterrey -- roughly about four percent of the market. Its rivals Telmex and Alestra each won about 43 percent.

But Avantel added that "tens of thousands of customers that have chosen Avantel in (the northern city of) Monterrey have not yet appeared in the official statistics." -- Mexico City newsroom, +525 728-9565
